questions.question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

2, 5, 11, 23, 47, ?, 191
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: **Each term ×** **2 + 1 = next term of the series**

2 × 2 + 1 = 5

5 × 2 + 1 = 11

11 × 2 + 1 = 23

23 × 2 + 1 = 47

**47 × 2 + 1 = 95**

95× 2 + 1 = 191 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No S is T.

II. Some U are S.

**Conclusions:**

1. Some U are not T.

II. All T are U.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
Given statements:

I. No S is T.

II. Some U are S.

The least possible diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/287c7147e21976d0a11819926f8367f152f77567b0bd5e5b69e00e31684a08ad.png] 

Conclusions:

1. Some U are not T - True (Because, No S is T and Some U are S, so Some U are not T)

II. All T are U - False (Because, There is no direct relation given between T and U)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question: Eight persons Reena, Kiran, Rahul, Deepak, Amit, Vikas, Preeti and Priya sit around a square table such that two persons sit in each of the sides. All the persons are sitting facing the centre of the table. Reena sits on the immediate right of Amit and they both sit on the same side. Preeti faces the one who is second to the left of Kiran. Preeti is sitting fourth to the right of Reena. Two persons sit between Vikas and Deepak (when counted from one side only) and Deepak is adjacent to Amit. Only one person sits between Preeti and Rahul (when counted from one side only). Who is sitting to the immediate left of Deepak?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight persons - Reena, Kiran, Rahul, Deepak, Amit, Vikas, Preeti and Priya

1) Reena sits on the immediate right of Amit and they both sit on the same side.

2) Preeti is sitting fourth to the right of Reena. 

3) Preeti faces the one who is second to the left of Kiran.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed1ab95ab926dc804116603fbaf5e41a077c75d931dc78eea618cc0ec054910d.png] 

4) Two persons sit between Vikas and Deepak (when counted from one side only) and Deepak is adjacent to Amit.

5) Only one person sits between Preeti and Rahul (when counted from one side only).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b562248d5e689d260d8710fa9d73aff2071b4af937a070034a579cb949fbbd2.png] 

So, **Priya **is sitting to the immediate left of Deepak.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

Here,

Similarly,

Library : Books → **Books** are items contained within a **Library**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

defghd _ fghd _ fghdef _ hdefgh _ efgh
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: defghd _ fghd _ fghdef _ hdefgh _ efgh 

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) fdgh → defgh / d **__f__** fgh / d __**d**__ fgh / def **g** h / defgh __**h**__ efgh 

**Option 2) eegd **→ defgh / d __e__ fgh / d __e__ fgh / def g h / defgh / __d__ efgh 

Here, '**defgh **' followed a pattern.

Option 3) efgh → defgh / d __e__ fgh / d **__f__** fgh / def g h / defgh / __h__ efgh 

Option 4) eged → defgh / d __e__ fgh / d __e__ fgh / def e h / defgh / __d__ efgh 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: If P + Q means P is the brother of Q, P × Q means P is the mother of Q, P÷ Q means P is the father of Q and P - Q means P is the sister of Q. If A × B + C - D ÷ E - F, then how is E related to A?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother 
 Sister 
 Mother 
 Father
 
 

 

Given: A × B + C - D ÷ E - F

It means: A is the mother of B, B is the brother of C, C is the sister of D, D is the father of E and E is the sister of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e343d46f28155a29e0e8d98c7a9e820c3a9b806bcafc4aa1e2be3e1289299cdc.png] 

So, E is the **'Son's daughter' **of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
